environment: Disposable local D1 registry + actual local Supabase GoTrue and Mailpit; Chrome

cases.scenario: Real local signup, SMTP verification, native browser login and synthetic passports
Workspace → public registry → listed shared passport → workspace, without signing in again
All 34 public/account route headers retain authenticated Workspace navigation and approved logos
Slow actual session read shows a checking state, never a false Sign in link
Interrupted session read offers retry and recovers the same real native session
Header retry updates the same session used by interactive public pages
Interrupted passport list cannot turn a valid user into a signed-out user; shared passport still opens
Passport session failure offers Retry opening page and restores access without new login
Foreign private passport stays inaccessible and logout restores the real login boundary
All served logo variants, compatibility SVG and packaged plugin artwork match the approved icon

limits: Transport interruptions are deliberate Playwright fault injection; no fabricated authenticated response
No production writes or customer-record modifications
Hosted installed-plugin catalog presentation remains separately blocked by App-owned branding controls
